doc.digest: Manage Max for Live Device banks for Push controllers.
doc.description: Create, edit and delete Max for Live Device parameter banks, as displayed on Ableton's Push controllers. Banks are saved with the device, but can be modified in real-time to cause updates on the Push display. For instance, you might want to reveal or hide particular parameters within a bank depending on device state.

methods.name: (mouse)
methods.digest: Double-click to open the Parameter Banks window.

methods.name: getcount
methods.digest: Report the current number of banks.

methods.name: getname
methods.digest: Report the name of a bank.

methods.name: getparameters
methods.digest: Report the parameters in a bank.
